text: PRE-REGISTERED RESULT (plan 8457830a2c5e). 16 protein-ligand complexes predicted with Boltz-2, 12 scorable. Fraction within 2 A = 0.4167; median RMSD 3.943 A. The distribution is sharply bimodal exactly as the registered justification predicted: hits fall at 0.31-0.81 A and misses at 3.3-17.4 A, with nothing in between. H1 FALSIFIED — the recall stratum reached 3/6 = 0.50, not the >0.50 required.

THE DECISIVE SEPARATION. Median pocket backbone RMSD is 0.454 A — the model reproduces the binding-site fold essentially perfectly — yet it places the ligand wrongly in 7 of 12 cases. Folding ability and docking ability are therefore distinguishable on this evidence, and confidence in the former licenses nothing about the latter. 23SI is the clearest case: pocket backbone 0.22 A, ligand 8.49 A away.

H2 FALSIFIED, and the honest reading is UNDERPOWERED rather than NULL. The interpolation premium is 0.1667 (recall 0.50 vs congeneric 0.33) against a 0.20 threshold, with Fisher exact p = 1.0 and Wilson intervals of [0.19,0.81] and [0.10,0.70] that almost entirely overlap. At n=6 per stratum only a very large premium could have been detected, which the registered plan stated as a known confound before any prediction ran.

THE RECEPTOR-DISJOINT STRATUM DOES NOT EXIST, and that is a finding about the PDB rather than a shortfall. 14 distinct receptors drawn from post-cutoff protein-ligand X-ray depositions were checked and EVERY ONE already had pre-cutoff entries, from 13 to 1172 (lysozyme). Recently deposited protein-ligand structures are overwhelmingly of already well characterised proteins. So this study measures the step from 'this exact complex was seen' to 'this pocket was seen with other ligands' — the smaller of the two gaps — and nothing here bears on novel folds.

PROTOCOL DEVIATION, declared. H3 (PoseBusters physical validity) was registered but NOT EXECUTED: the analysis never wired PoseBusters in, so it is reported as NOT_TESTED rather than as a result. The prespec audit also flags n_observed=12 against n_planned=16. Four entries failed for recorded reasons: one Boltz declined (heme, an organometallic), one had no parsable reference ligand, and two could not be matched to their SMILES template.

TWO SCORING BUGS FOUND AND FIXED, both of which produced confident nonsense before being caught. (1) Residues were paired by residue NUMBER between a model numbered 1..N and a crystal using author numbering with an offset; on 4XH6 only 4.2% of such pairs were even the same amino acid, and the pocket RMSD read 15.13 A where the truth is 0.56 A. Fixed by global sequence alignment, with a guard that refuses any pair whose residue types differ. (2) Multi-copy ligands were counted as one molecule, giving reference atom counts that were exact multiples of the prediction (56 vs 14, 60 vs 30, 74 vs 37). Fixed by grouping copies and taking the best match.
